# 2. Players must speak English and be at least 18 years old.
Space Station 14 contains many violent themes and adult topics that are only suitable for an adult audience. To play on this server or participate in the Discord or other areas of the community, players are expected to be 18 years or older. If behaviors, actions, or statements imply the possibility of a player being under 18, staff will reach out and verify their age. We can not guarantee support in languages other than English, so RP on the server is expected to be done in English.
